name: Palette swatch
summary: A theme's colour palette shown as five rounded chips of rising heights, the presenter's theme-thumbnail palette.
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-palette-swatch>, for showing a theme's colour palette inside a theme card or picker. Five rounded bars of rising heights sit on a 152:33 frame that fills the host's width; `colors` (pipe-separated) fills them in order. The colours are the theme's own data, not DS hues, so the element paints whatever the host passes; a palette shorter than five, or an invalid entry, leaves that chip outlined and unfilled. Decorative by default (aria-hidden); give it a `label` and it becomes role="img" with that name. Shadow DOM built once; a `colors` change restyles the persistent chips in place.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render across frameworks. The chips are persistent nodes; a new `colors` value only changes their inline background. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Frame
spec.value: width 100% of the host, aspect-ratio 152 / 33, 5-column grid, column gap 1.65% (2.5 of 152)

spec.label: Chips
spec.value: heights 81% · 57% · 96% · 72% · 48% of the frame, bottom-aligned; radius xs 4 on the top corners, plus the outer bottom corner on the first and last chip

spec.label: Stroke
spec.value: 0.5px Gray 35 #EBEBEB on every chip, filled or not

spec.label: Fill
spec.value: the first five `colors` in order; a missing or invalid entry leaves that chip unfilled (stroke only)

props.name: colors
props.desc: Pipe-separated CSS colours from the theme, e.g. "#1A1A1A|#E70E68|#4A4A4A"; the first five are used

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name. Set → role="img" with this aria-label; unset → decorative (aria-hidden)

props.name: ::part(frame) / ::part(chip)
props.desc: Layout hooks only (position, margin); never restyle the chips

whenToUse.when: a theme card, theme picker or theme gallery that previews the theme's colour palette
the user picks ONE colour (use <aha-color-picker>, whose swatches are selectable controls)

opinion.note: The chips show a theme's own colours, so they take any colour the theme holds; they are a read-only preview, never a control. Put the click on the card that contains them, not on the chips.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The probe is 152px wide with five colours, so the third chip is the tallest and every chip carries the Gray 35 stroke.

selfCheck.label: five chips at rising heights, 152:33 frame
short palette leaves later chips outlined

highlights: Five rising chips filled from a theme's palette
Shorter palettes leave later chips outlined
Fills its host's width at a 152:33 ratio
